skills.name: stripe-billing
skills.description: Stripe billing guardrails for SaaS applications. Auto-activates when working with Stripe, payments, subscriptions, webhooks, checkout, entitlements, usage billing, credit systems, or billing lifecycle management.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Audit your codebase for Stripe billing violations, security risks, and missing edge case handling. Scans for hardcoded prices, exposed keys, missing webhook coverage, lifecycle gaps, usage billing issues, and entitlement vulnerabilities.

commands.name: discover
commands.description: Interactive discovery to understand your billing requirements before writing any code. Detects your stack and guides you through pricing models, lifecycle rules, usage billing, credit systems, entity billing, and entitlement architecture.

commands.name: feature-gating-requirements
headings: Feature Gating Requirements Discovery & Test Validation
Q1. List every feature your app gates by plan or payment.
Q2. Do any features share a common balance pool (credit system)?
Q3. Do you need a product-level check (owns product X) OR only feature-level checks?
Q4. For each metered feature, what happens when the limit is hit?

commands.name: implement
commands.description: Implement Stripe billing based on BILLING_REQUIREMENTS.md. Generates production-ready code with guardrails for webhooks, entitlements, usage billing, credit systems, lifecycle management, and edge case handling.

headings: What It Covers (4,000+ lines of billing intelligence)
